title: Workplace injury reporting
prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting reportable workplace accidents

1. Start with the incident records.
2.
completion:
Gather incident data.
3. Identify the injured party.
4. Record the type of injury.
5. Note the circumstances of the incident.
6. Document the location of the injury.
7. Record the time and date of the incident.
8. List the immediate response (first aid, medical treatment, etc.).
9. Include witness statements, if possible. 
10. Record any equipment or environmental issues involved.
11. Note the actions taken immediately following the accident (general clean-up, safety intervention, etc.).
12. Document any corrective actions planned or undertaken.
13. Attach photographs, if available.
14. Record lost workdays, if any.
15. Consult legal or HR guidance and follow company-specific accident reporting protocols.
16. Complete and submit the necessary accident report forms.
17. Ensure confidentiality and data privacy.
18. Maintain a record of the report for future reference.
19. Conduct a thorough investigation if required and document findings.
20
